name: StatGate cross-service tenant/authorization attestation
notes: Each entry names an unauthenticated GET that MUST fail closed when no credentials are supplied.
Expected statuses were verified live against the running Compose stack on 2026-09-15.
StatIoT is the reference case where the shared tenant.GinWorkspaceContext runs BEFORE auth validation: malformed X-Workspace-ID yields 400 even without credentials.
All other services return 401 when unauthenticated, which also proves fail-closed: no credentialed/anonymous path serves tenant data.
public_ok services intentionally serve unauthenticated reads (helpdesk ticket list, citizen session creation). They are NOT in this probe set; they are covered by authenticated-mutation checks in CI.

Phase-2 resource-level scoping (datasets/pipelines, gateways/devices/alerts, layers, processes, leads, agents) and seeded-object write/read certification are tracked in Roadmap/PHASE_SERVICE_MATRIX.md.

AUTHENTICATED CALIBRATION (2026-09-15): a Registry-signed HS256 token (userId/role/tenant_id/iss/aud, statgate-lib validator contract) was minted and replayed. authed_auth = status with a valid token and no workspace header; authed_malformed = status with a valid token plus a malformed X-Workspace-ID; authed_unknown_ws = status with a valid token plus a well-formed but nonexistent workspace, or null when the route does not enforce workspace membership.

IMPORTANT nuance: authed_unknown_ws 503 (workspace_membership_unavailable) is what this synthetic principal produces today. The membership middleware asks Enterprise Core GET /workspaces/{id} with the caller token; Enterprise Core answers 401 for a principal it has no record of (not 403/404), so the middleware degrades to 503. All three of 400/403/503 are denials, so the route is fail-closed; a genuine 403 requires a real provisioned Enterprise Core user. Tests assert membership_enforced via the denial set, not one hardcoded code.

FOLLOW-UP FINDING: statspatial, statops and statchat read routes return 200 for a well-formed unknown workspace (no membership enforcement on that route; list scoping only). stattrust returns 400 and enterprise-core/statcollect return 401 with this synthetic principal because they validate the principal against their own store. These are recorded as notes/follow-ups, not passes.
